title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a paired-luminary heading has global scope while figure texts have local owners
summary: The recorded Ghent MS92 f92r Liber Floridus lead has a heading about the course of Sun and Moon beside one wheel that labels both bodies. Verify the complete primary page and freeze which words govern the pair, which labels belong to one figure, and the written course relation. Then ask whether a complete reading of only the admitted f68r2 medallion texts and eligible nearby labels requires a shared two-body relation or gives each face an independent record. The f68r2 upper/lower order and topology differ from Ghent; a pictorial analogy alone cannot transfer scope. No Voynich word value, course direction, or unadmitted f68r2 text is asserted. Without an independently owned cross-register link, report missing meaning binding rather than score a match.

design.mechanism: an explicitly source-written course heading governs two separately named celestial bodies while local labels retain individual figure ownership

design.contrast: one written paired course with global scope versus two unrelated local celestial records
